facts.text: The hotel has a heated pool overlooking Nakajima Park and nearby mountains.
facts.excerpt: a heated pool overlooking Nakajima Park and nearby mountains

facts.text: The indoor heated pool is on the 9th floor.
facts.excerpt: in our indoor heated pool on the 9th floor

facts.text: Complimentary morning wellness sessions include poolside yoga, Pilates and a floating sound bath in the indoor heated pool.
facts.excerpt: Start your day with complimentary morning wellness at InterContinental Sapporo. Enjoy poolside yoga, Pilates and a floating sound bath in our indoor heated pool on the 9th floor.

facts.text: The Serenity Suite measures 160 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Room Size:  160 sq. m. – 160 sq. m.

facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge is on the 14th floor and offers gourmet breakfasts, seasonal afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 14th floor, the exclusive Club InterContinental Lounge offers a personalized retreat with attentive service, featuring gourmet breakfasts, seasonal afternoon tea, and evening cocktails.

facts.text: SAWAKA is a contemporary kappo restaurant where dishes are prepared at a live chef's counter, blending traditional Japanese techniques with modern creativity.
facts.excerpt: a contemporary kappo restaurant in Sapporo showcasing premium ingredients from Hokkaido and beyond. Experience refined dishes that blend traditional Japanese techniques with modern creativity, prepared at a live chef

facts.text: AuBlanc serves modern casual French cuisine with the flavors of Hokkaido.
facts.excerpt: a French restaurant in Sapporo where modern casual French cuisine meets the flavors of Hokkaido

facts.text: Norva serves signature afternoon tea by day and becomes a bar for original cocktails and mocktails made with Hokkaido ingredients at night.
facts.excerpt: By day, enjoy signature Afternoon Tea with premium teas, seasonal sweets, and savory bites. By night, the lounge transforms into an elegant bar serving original cocktails and mocktails made with Hokkaido ingredients

facts.text: Guests can relax at the summer terrace with river views.
facts.excerpt: relaxing moments at the lounge, bar, or summer terrace with river views

facts.text: The nearest public transport listed is Nakajima-Kōen Station, by Nakajima Park.
The hotel is in Chuo-ku, Sapporo, at Minami 10-jo Nishi 1-chome.
The hotel is about 52.8 kilometers from New Chitose Airport.
facts.excerpt: approximately 32.81 miles away (52.8 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Pets are not allowed, though guide dogs and service animals are.
facts.excerpt: Guide Dogs or Service Animals Allowed

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as an elegant retreat where Hokkaido's natural beauty meets modern refinement.
